newsitem.title: USA: Echlin talks on Midland-Grau sale end.
newsitem.headline: Echlin talks on Midland-Grau sale end.

text.p: Echlin Inc said on Friday that talks on the proposed sale of its Midland-Grau heavy-duty brake operations had been discontinued.

The negotiations, which were conducted with AlliedSignal Inc, and with the joint ventures of AlliedSignal and Knorr-Bremse AG, followed the companies' February announcement that they had signed a letter of intent in the proposed deal.

"The sharp fall-off in European heavy-truck production, resulting in disparate synergistic benefits for the parties involved, led to the termination of negotiations," said Echlin president Larry McCurdy.
"Echlin will now consider alternate strategies regarding the future of its global heavy-duty brake business," he added.
Echlin, headquartered in Branford, manufactures and distributes motor vehicle brake, engine, power transmission, steering and suspension system parts.
